start: Member page of a member who owes ₹1,500 on one membership; owner signed in, online

steps.action: Tap "Collect payment" at the top of the member page
user_sees: Sheet titled "Collect payment"
"From <member name> · ₹1,500 due in total"
"For which membership" showing "<plan> (<start day>) — ₹1,500 due"
"Amount received" empty with ₹1,500 in grey and "Leave blank to collect the full amount due."
"Paid by", "Reference (optional)", "Received on" set to today
"This clears all dues on this membership."
must_not: An amount of zero when money is due
A cancelled membership in the list

steps.action: Leave the amount blank, keep "Paid by" as it is and tap "Save payment"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"
The sheet closes
"Payment saved. Receipt <number>."
must_not: Two receipts
A receipt for more than ₹1,500

user_sees: No dues; the "Collect payment" button is gone; the receipt is in the payments list
must_not: The due still shown
The button still offered

start: Money, Dues list, a row of a member who owes money

user_sees: The same "Collect payment" sheet for that member
must_not: "That member could not be opened. Try reloading the page." for a member who is on the list

user_sees: "Payment saved."
The row leaves the Dues list
must_not: The row still listed with the old amount

start: Member page of a member who owes on two memberships; a part payment by UPI received three days ago

steps.action: Open "Collect payment" and pick the second membership in "For which membership"
user_sees: The amount box empties; the grey amount is that membership's due
must_not: The amount typed for the first membership carried over

user_sees: "Still due after this: ₹<due − 500>" in the warning colour
must_not: "This clears all dues on this membership." for a part payment

steps.action: Set "Paid by" to UPI, type a reference, set "Received on" to three days ago and save
user_sees: "Payment saved. Receipt <number>."
must_not: The receipt dated today
The reference lost

user_sees: Paid, still due and total add up; "Collect payment" is still there
must_not: The membership shown as fully paid

start: Collect payment sheet open for a membership with ₹1,500 due

user_sees: "That is more than the ₹1,500 due on this membership."
Neither "Still due after this" nor "This clears all dues" is shown
must_not: A receipt for ₹2,000
The membership shown with a minus balance

user_sees: "Type an amount more than zero."
must_not: A receipt for ₹0

user_sees: "That amount looks wrong. Type it again."
must_not: The full due collected instead

steps.action: Set "Received on" to tomorrow and save
user_sees: "The payment date can’t be in the future."
must_not: A receipt dated in the future

user_sees: "Pick the date you got this money."
must_not: A raw message such as "Not a YYYY-MM-DD date"

steps.action: Type a date with the year 0002 and save
user_sees: "That date looks wrong. Check the year."
must_not: A receipt number nobody can read back

start: Member page of a member who owes ₹1,500

user_sees: "Payment saved. Receipt <number>."
must_not: The due unchanged

user_sees: "₹1,000 due in total" and ₹1,000 in grey in the amount box
must_not: ₹1,500 offered again

user_sees: The "Collect payment" button leaves the member page
must_not: The button still shown with nothing due

steps.action: Open the sheet for this member from a Dues list that was not refreshed
user_sees: "<Member name> has no dues. Every membership is fully paid." and no Save button
must_not: A form that lets money be taken against nothing

start: Help article "Renew a membership or collect a payment" says: Tap "Collect payment" (it shows only when money is due). What's new says the app no longer takes more than the member owes

steps.action: Open a member with no dues, then a member with dues
user_sees: No "Collect payment" button on the first; the button on the second
must_not: The button on a member who owes nothing

steps.action: Try to save more than is due
user_sees: "That is more than the ₹<due> due on this membership."
must_not: More money recorded than the member owes

steps.action: Check who can see the sheet's facts
user_sees: The member's name, total due, plan names and dates: the same facts the owner and the desk already see on the member page
must_not: Another gym's member or dues in the list

start: Member page of a member who owes ₹1,500; front desk login, online

user_sees: Sheet "Collect payment" with the member's name and "₹1,500 due in total"
Under "Received on": "Today, or up to 31 days back."
must_not: The owner-only totals of the gym

steps.action: Take the cash, leave the amount blank and tap "Save payment"
user_sees: "Saving…", then "Payment saved. Receipt <number>."
must_not: Two receipts after one tap

user_sees: No dues left
must_not: The due still shown

start: Money, Dues list, as the front desk

user_sees: The "Collect payment" sheet for that member
must_not: A sheet for a different member than the row tapped

user_sees: "Payment saved."
must_not: The row dropping off the Dues list while money is still due

start: Collect payment sheet open at the front desk

steps.action: Set "Received on" to 40 days ago and tap "Save payment"
user_sees: "The front desk can date a payment at most 31 days back. Ask the owner to enter older payments."
must_not: A receipt back-dated 40 days by a desk login

steps.action: Set it to exactly 31 days ago and save
user_sees: The payment is saved
must_not: A refusal on the last allowed day

user_sees: "That is more than the ₹<due> due on this membership."
must_not: The extra money recorded

start: Front desk; a member paid part yesterday and comes back with the rest

user_sees: Only what is still due is offered
must_not: Yesterday's amount offered again

user_sees: "Payment saved. Receipt <number>."; the button leaves the page
must_not: A second receipt with yesterday's number

steps.action: The owner later cancels (voids) that receipt; open the member again
user_sees: The due is back and "Collect payment" is shown again
must_not: The membership still shown as paid after its receipt was cancelled
